intro h
split
· intro H
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq'⟩ := ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_exists_q.mp h H
  exact ⟨q, hq, mul_le_mul_left hq' (le_rfl (ArchimedeanClass.mk_nonneg y))⟩
· rintro ⟨q, hq, hq'⟩
  have hq'' : 0 < |y| := le_antisymm (zero_le _) (ArchimedeanClass.mk_nonneg y)
  have hq''' : |x| ≤ |y| := mul_le_mul_left hq' hq''
  exact ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_exists_q.mpr hq'''
